topic.title: Listed Buildings / Conservation Areas / Heritage Consent
topic.source_contract: designation identity, extent and grade, significance assessment, setting, conservation-area appraisal, consent route, planning permission, conditions, approved details, works, recording and post-work heritage evidence

scope_guards: A list entry is not treated as consent for works.
A conservation-area appraisal is not treated as a planning decision.
Planning permission is not treated as listed building consent.
Listed building consent is not treated as discharge of conditions.
An approved method statement is not treated as completed works.
Completed works are not treated as compliant without approved-detail comparison.
A heritage statement is not treated as proof of preserved significance.
No score or promotion is written without exact designation, consent, approved details, works and post-work evidence.
